title: Close Readmission Before the Span: Extension Days in Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, a close readmission adds days to an extension of an approved authorization.

## Source record

The date of the patient's most recent inpatient mental health admission line on the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines, counted in days before the span's first day.

## Schedule

| Most recent admission line dated before the span's first day by | Days added |
|---|---|
| 1 to 7 days | 2 |
| more than 7 and no more than 30 days | 1 |
| any other interval, on or after the span's first day, or no line | 0 |

In words: where the patient's most recent inpatient mental health admission line is dated before the span's first day by no more than seven days, two days are added; where it is dated before the span's first day by more than seven and no more than thirty days, one day is added; otherwise none.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical; span first day 15 April)

- Admission line 8 April (7 days before): 2 days added.
- Admission line 7 April (8 days before): 1 day added.
- Admission line 16 March (30 days before): 1 day added.
- Admission line 15 March (31 days before): none.
